description: This source file contains an extension for the ChannelsSettings class, adding private utility functions and computed properties to manage the status, appearance, and details of various communication channels (like WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, etc.) within a SwiftUI-based user interface. It includes methods for retrieving channel statuses, generating UI indicators (tints, summaries, details), and handling last check timestamps for each channel.

classes.name: ChannelsSettings
classes.description: A class managing the status, UI representation, and interactions with various communication channels within the system, extended here with additional private utility functions and computed properties.

methods.name: channelStatus
methods.description: Fetches and decodes the status snapshot for a specified channel ID with a given type.

methods.name: configuredChannelTint
